newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys June unleaded reformate at $25.30/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys June unleaded reformate at $25.30/bbl.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought two unleaded 95-octane reformate cargoes for June 11-30 delivery around $25.30 per barrel cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Taiwan, a company official said on Tuesday.
The official said the cargoes, awarded to two different traders, are to be delivered to Keelung or Taichung.
The tender closed May 5 and was valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought an unexpected three unleaded and one leaded cargo for May 16-31 and June 1-15 arrival at $24.60-$24.70 per barrel and $25.20, respectively, on a c-and-f basis.
